summary: Reader assistant: a quoted selection no longer fills the whole panel. The UI redesign had dropped the quote card layout (no line clamp), so a long selection pushed the log out of view. The quote now sits in a composer below the log as a two-line card with page and length, expandable in place (capped at 30vh); the log keeps a minimum height. Also: Enter during Chinese IME composition no longer sends, Shift+Enter adds a line (textarea auto-grows), a question typed while an answer is pending is no longer wiped, send is disabled while busy, the quote in a sent message is shown above the question, clearing the log restores the starter questions, and the duplicated paper title line is folded into the header.
scope_note: Frontend presentation and input handling of the reader assistant only; /api/qa and its prompt are unchanged.

budget_impact.rationale: No prompt, provider, retry or context change; the request body sent to /api/qa is unchanged.
budget_impact.before: One gateway call per question sent.
budget_impact.after: One gateway call per question sent.
budget_impact.developer_usage: One real paper_qa call was made while verifying in the browser preview (the preview data directory holds a configured key); its token count was shown in the app toast, not recorded here.

checks.note: Run in the owner's terminal because the agent sandbox blocks localhost binds; the evidence file also records the node tests.

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; selected a 5.4k-character passage in the reader preview and measured quote/log heights, exercised IME Enter, busy send, expand/collapse and a real answer.

open_risks: /api/qa has no length cap on the quoted selection (translation caps at ~1200 chars); a whole-page quote is sent in full. The card now shows the character count, but a cap is a prompt/budget change left for owner decision.
Verified in the Chromium preview; the .app WKWebView layout and IME behaviour need the owner's check.
